findings.message: ADRが未定義のトラック内識別子「G24実装」を参照し、上流のADRから将来の実装成果物へ逆方向の依存を作っています。G24への言及を削除するか、永続的なADR上の設計決定として参照してください（同じ問題がReassess Whenにもあります）。

The shipped-config regression test in apps/cli/src/commands/phase.rs still uses include_str! on this file and asserts that spec-design has two pre-entry commands, including the removed adr final-review command. With the current one-command array, test_shipped_phase_commands_declare_direct_upstream_convergence_matrix will fail and block CI. Update that expectation to reflect the adjudicated interim configuration.

`CapabilityProfilePort` is an `action: reference` usecase catalogue entry but is absent from every task attribution (T001/T002 are the relevant convergence tasks). Reference entries still require an owner; the current document produces an `OrphanEntry` from `bin/sotp task-contract coverage`.

`CapabilityProviderPort` is an `action: reference` usecase catalogue entry but is absent from every task attribution (T001/T003 are the relevant convergence tasks). Reference entries still require an owner; the current document produces an `OrphanEntry` from `bin/sotp task-contract coverage`.

B2 is avoidable serialization. In B1, T001 and T004 are initially ready; placing T001 first makes T002 and T003 ready in that same batch. Their targets do not overlap (`usecase::capability_exec`, `README.md`, agent-profile DTO/adapter files, and the Codex adapter), and the combined per-scope estimates remain within the 500-line ceiling: usecase 170, infrastructure 445, and harness-policy 90. T002 and T003 can therefore join B1 after T001.

T002 names `infrastructure::agent_profiles::AgentProfilesCapabilityAdapter`, but that symbol does not exist there; its catalogue/source target is `infrastructure::capability_exec::agent_profiles::AgentProfilesCapabilityAdapter`, while the DTOs belong under `agent_profiles`. Correct the separate targets so the executor does not have to infer the task boundary.

T004 bundles three independently verifiable documentation units while still `todo`: provider configuration and compatibility guidance (IN-03/AC-03), typed-pipeline verification status (CN-02/AC-04), and data-residency/default-profile policy (IN-04/CN-03/AC-05). Split these units into separately verifiable tasks and update their coverage, estimates, and batch membership.
T004のdescriptionはAC-03の具体的なプロバイダー互換性・設定挙動を再記述しています。許可される形式（target + operation + anchor cite）に留め、上流契約の本文を重複させないでください。See .harness/policies/no-upstream-restatement.md.
T005のdescriptionはAC-04の「typed-pipeline未検証」および検証条件をそのまま行動契約として再記述しています。See .harness/policies/no-upstream-restatement.md.
T006のdescriptionはAC-05のデータレジデンシー、デフォルトプロファイル、CI/self-hosted routeの契約を再記述しています。See .harness/policies/no-upstream-restatement.md.
section.id `consumer-provider-guidance` のdescriptionはAC-03〜AC-05の互換性、検証状態、データレジデンシー方針を上流契約として再記述しています。See .harness/policies/no-upstream-restatement.md.

The `usecase::CapabilityInputValidationError` docs restate the fail-closed behavior contract instead of referring to the upstream anchor; keep the entry description to the changed type/variant and anchor cite per `.harness/policies/no-upstream-restatement.md`.

The `usecase::CapabilityProfile` docs restate routing behavior and provider-identity preservation; this behavior belongs in the spec, while the catalogue docs should identify the changed field and cite the relevant anchors.
The `infrastructure::AgentProfilesCapabilityAdapter` docs restate propagation behavior from trusted profiles; replace the behavioral prose with a concise change description plus anchor cite.
The `infrastructure::CapabilityConfigDto` docs restate the typed-vs-raw configuration design rationale; catalogue docs must reference the upstream contract rather than reproduce it.
The `infrastructure::CodexCapabilityAdapter` docs restate the CLI emission and provider-preservation behavior; keep this entry to the changed adapter surface and anchor cite.
The `infrastructure::ModelProviderNameDto` docs restate boundary conversion and raw-string avoidance rationale; describe the DTO surface and cite the upstream anchors instead.

`infrastructure::AgentProfilesCapabilityAdapter` is declared `modify`, but the frozen rustdoc baseline already has the same private-field struct shape and the identical `new(PathBuf, PathBuf) -> Self` signature. Only existing port-method behavior is planned to change, so this TypeEntry does not describe a structural modification and is already blue before that work occurs. Declare the baseline-identical type/impl identity as `reference`.

`infrastructure::CodexCapabilityAdapter` is declared `modify`, although its frozen-baseline shape and `new(PathBuf, PathBuf, Arc<dyn ProviderSessionCachePort>, Option<TrackId>) -> CodexCapabilityAdapter` signature are unchanged. The intended dispatch-body change is not a TypeEntry shape change, so this declaration cannot detect implementation progress; use `reference` for the baseline-identical type/impl identity.

`usecase::ModelProviderName::try_new` can structurally produce only `EmptyModelProviderName`, but its return type exposes all eight `CapabilityInputValidationError` variants. The method docs do not name the exact producible variant or justify that breadth, forcing callers to account for seven impossible cases. Use an operation-specific error or explicitly constrain the documented reachable subset.

`infrastructure::ModelProviderNameDto::try_new` merely delegates validation to `ModelProviderName::try_new`, so it likewise can produce only `EmptyModelProviderName` while exposing the eight-variant `CapabilityInputValidationError`. Its docs neither enumerate that sole reachable variant nor justify the broad error surface; narrow the error or document the precise subset.

`usecase::CapabilityProfile` exposes `provider: ProviderName` and `model_provider: Option<ModelProviderName>` as independent public fields. This permits `model_provider: Some(...)` with a non-Codex provider, even though AC-02 requires profiles using `model_provider` to retain `provider = codex`. No constructor or enum enforces that relationship, so an invalid routing state is representable; encode the binding as a validated composite/enum or use private fields with a validating constructor.

The `usecase::CapabilityProfile` docs restate the behavioral invariant that only `CodexCustom` may carry a custom provider. Keep the catalogue description to the changed shape and anchor citation per `.harness/policies/no-upstream-restatement.md`.
The `usecase::CapabilityProviderBinding` docs restate variant behavior and the provider-pairing invariant. This behavior belongs upstream; the catalogue should identify the type and cite anchors.

The `infrastructure::AgentProfilesCapabilityAdapter` docs restate the implementation's profile-mapping behavior despite being a baseline reference. Use a concise type/reference description with anchor citation.

The `infrastructure::CapabilityConfigDto` docs restate deserialization flow and the downstream profile-construction behavior. Replace the behavioral prose with the changed surface and anchor citation.

The `infrastructure::CapabilityProviderBindingDto` docs restate variant semantics and the custom-deserialization rejection rule. Catalogue docs must reference the upstream behavior rather than reproduce it.
The `infrastructure::CodexCapabilityAdapter` docs restate dispatch behavior while declaring a baseline reference. Keep the description limited to the reference surface and anchor citation.
